settings.appearanceDesc: Language and theme, stored only in this browser
settings.readerSectionDesc: Default reading preferences, stored only in this browser; individual manga can override them from the reader
settings.incognitoDesc: Reading progress is saved as usual, but no reading history is recorded; per-manga incognito is available on the manga detail page
settings.securityDesc: The web UI and REST API share the same username and password
settings.passwordChanged: Password changed; please log in again
settings.authDisabled: Authentication is disabled; set SUMIDOKU_AUTH_PASSWORD and restart to enable it
settings.apiKeysDesc: Bearer credentials for scripts and third-party clients, acting as the admin
settings.apiKeyCreatedHint: This key is shown only once; copy it now, it cannot be viewed again
settings.revokeApiKeyConfirm: Revoke key “{{name}}”? Clients using it stop working immediately
settings.downloadDesc: Automatic downloads, read-driven cleanup, and reader-ahead behavior; changes apply without a restart
settings.downloadSkipUnread: Skip titles with pre-existing unread chapters
settings.deleteAfterManualRead: Delete after manually marking a chapter read
settings.deleteAfterRead: Delete after finishing a chapter in the reader
settings.allowDeleteBookmarked: Allow read-driven deletion of bookmarked chapters
settings.downloadAhead: Download upcoming unread chapters while reading
settings.excludedDownloadCategoriesDesc: Titles in these categories are skipped only for automatic downloads; manual downloads remain available
settings.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete category "{{name}}"? Its manga stay in the library.
settings.libraryDesc: How the library page renders, stored on the server
settings.defaultCategoryHint: The chip the library opens on when you have never picked one yourself; your own chip selection always wins afterwards
settings.showUncategorized: Show the uncategorized chip on the library page
settings.libraryUpdateDesc: Global update schedule and title selection, applied to manual and scheduled library updates
settings.libraryExcludedUpdateCategoriesDesc: Titles in these categories are skipped during library-wide updates; manually updating a category ignores its exclusion
settings.filterGroupsDesc: Named rule sets that filter the library; groups are chips above the category strip
settings.deleteGroupConfirm: Delete filter group "{{name}}"? The library itself is not touched.
settings.serverSettingsDesc: Generic key-value storage; backup.* keys are read and written by the "Automatic backup" section — edit them there
settings.restored: Restored: {{library}} library · {{categories}} categories · {{progress}} progress · {{settings}} settings · {{sourceSettings}} source settings
settings.restoredAll: All entries restored; nothing was skipped
settings.importedWithTrackers: Imported: {{library}} library · {{categories}} categories · {{progress}} progress · {{trackers}} tracker bindings
settings.importedAll: All entries imported; nothing was skipped
settings.skippedNoSource: The following entries were skipped (matching source not installed, or tracker not supported by this server):
settings.willSkipNoSource: The following entries will be skipped because the matching source is not installed or the tracker has no matching provider here:
settings.importMergeWarn: The import merges incrementally: existing library entries and categories are kept as-is, and reading progress takes the larger value. This cannot be undone.
settings.importMergeWarnSuwayomi: The import merges incrementally: existing library entries and categories are kept as-is, and reading progress takes the larger value. This cannot be undone. Only sources with a unique matching name are auto-matched; the rest must be mapped manually.
settings.backupDesc: Export the library, categories, progress and settings for migration; backup files contain source settings (possibly source-site credentials), so keep them safe. You can also import Aidoku's .aib or Suwayomi/Mihon's .tachibk backups (library, categories, reading progress and tracker bindings; merged incrementally without overwriting current state)
settings.willImportWithTrackers: Will import: {{library}} library · {{categories}} categories · {{progress}} progress · {{trackers}} tracker bindings
settings.sourceMapping: Mapping between sources in the backup and installed sources:
settings.unmappedSkipped_one: Sources without a mapping are skipped as whole groups ({{count}} entry).
settings.unmappedSkipped_other: Sources without a mapping are skipped as whole groups ({{count}} entries).
settings.restorePickWithDate: Backup created at {{date}}; choose what to restore:
settings.restoreWarn: The import overwrites this instance's corresponding state with the selected content and cannot be undone; the backup may contain source-site credentials, so only proceed if you trust the file's source.
settings.invalidBackupJson: The backup file is not valid JSON
settings.downloadMoveDescShort: After packing, move the artifact to the path rendered from the template (e.g. a mounted comics library directory); leave empty to keep it in place
settings.downloadMoveDesc: After packing, move the artifact to the path rendered from the template (e.g. a mounted comics library directory); leave empty to keep it in place. If the move fails, the artifact stays in the downloads directory and the download is unaffected
settings.moveTemplateHint: Variables: {source} source name · {title}/{manga} manga title · {author} author · {artist} artist · {chapter} chapter name · {filename} default file name (without extension); when the template contains {filename} the rendered result is the full file name, otherwise it is treated as a directory and the default artifact name is appended. Headless deployments can override with SUMIDOKU_DOWNLOAD_MOVE_PATH
settings.autoBackupDesc: Writes a full backup to a server directory on a schedule; the oldest backups beyond the retention count are cleaned up automatically, and the newest one is always kept
settings.minInteger: Please enter an integer no smaller than {{min}}
settings.backupDirHint: Change the directory via SUMIDOKU_BACKUP_DIR or the backup.dir setting; last backup: {{lastRun}}
settings.restoreNamedConfirm: Restoring the backup created at {{date}} overwrites this instance's library, categories, progress and all settings. This cannot be undone.
settings.backupTrustWarn: The backup may contain source-site credentials; make sure you trust the file's source.
